skills.name: Appraise
skills.description: Estimate the value of common or rare objects.

skills.name: Balance
skills.description: Keep your footing on narrow or uneven surfaces.

skills.name: Bluff
skills.description: Convince others that something untrue is genuine.

skills.name: Climb
skills.description: Climb slopes, walls and other surfaces.

skills.name: Concentration
skills.description: Maintain focus while distracted or threatened.

skills.name: Craft
skills.description: Make or repair an item; choose a craft speciality when adding it.

skills.name: Decipher Script
skills.description: Understand unfamiliar writing, coded messages and incomplete texts.

skills.name: Diplomacy
skills.description: Influence attitudes and negotiate peacefully.

skills.name: Disable Device
skills.description: Disarm traps and sabotage devices.

skills.name: Disguise
skills.description: Change your appearance or impersonate someone.

skills.name: Escape Artist
skills.description: Escape from bonds, grapples and tight spaces.

skills.name: Forgery
skills.description: Create or detect forged documents.

skills.name: Gather Information
skills.description: Learn rumours and information through conversation.

skills.name: Handle Animal
skills.description: Handle, train and control animals.

skills.name: Heal
skills.description: Treat wounds, illness, poison and other conditions.

skills.name: Hide
skills.description: Avoid being seen.

skills.name: Intimidate
skills.description: Influence others through threats and force of personality.

skills.name: Jump
skills.description: Make long, high and other jumps.

skills.name: Knowledge (Arcana)
skills.description: Knowledge of magic, mysteries, spells and magical traditions.

skills.name: Knowledge (Architecture and Engineering)
skills.description: Knowledge of buildings, construction and engineering.

skills.name: Knowledge (Dungeoneering)
skills.description: Knowledge of aberrations, caverns, oozes and underground environments.

skills.name: Knowledge (Geography)
skills.description: Knowledge of lands, terrain, climate and people.

skills.name: Knowledge (History)
skills.description: Knowledge of historical events, people, wars and ancient cultures.

skills.name: Knowledge (Local)
skills.description: Knowledge of local people, laws, customs and settlements.

skills.name: Knowledge (Nature)
skills.description: Knowledge of animals, plants, seasons and natural cycles.

skills.name: Knowledge (Nobility and Royalty)
skills.description: Knowledge of noble lineages, heraldry, royalty and etiquette.

skills.name: Knowledge (Religion)
skills.description: Knowledge of deities, religious traditions, undead and divine matters.

skills.name: Knowledge (The Planes)
skills.description: Knowledge of the planes, outsiders and planar phenomena.

skills.name: Listen
skills.description: Hear approaching enemies, conversations and other sounds.

skills.name: Move Silently
skills.description: Move without being heard.

skills.name: Open Lock
skills.description: Pick locks.

skills.name: Perform
skills.description: Perform; choose a speciality such as act, comedy, dance, keyboard, oratory, percussion, string, wind or sing.

skills.name: Profession
skills.description: Practise a vocation; choose a profession when adding it.

skills.name: Ride
skills.description: Control and ride a mount.

skills.name: Search
skills.description: Find hidden objects, traps and secret doors.

skills.name: Sense Motive
skills.description: Detect deception and discern a creature's intentions.

skills.name: Sleight of Hand
skills.description: Palm objects, pick pockets and perform tricks.

skills.name: Speak Language
skills.description: Learn a language; each rank grants a language rather than a check bonus.

skills.name: Spellcraft
skills.description: Identify spells, magic effects and magical writing.

skills.name: Spot
skills.description: Notice creatures, details and hidden objects.

skills.name: Survival
skills.description: Track, find food and shelter, and survive in the wild.

skills.name: Swim
skills.description: Swim in water and avoid drowning.

skills.name: Tumble
skills.description: Move acrobatically through threatened spaces and reduce falling damage.

skills.name: Use Magic Device
skills.description: Activate magic items as though you had the required abilities.

skills.name: Use Rope
skills.description: Tie knots, bind creatures and work with ropes.

notes: Craft, Perform and Profession can be selected more than once for different specialities. Knowledge is listed separately for each of its ten fields. Speak Language ranks grant languages rather than a normal skill-check bonus. Class-skill status depends on character class; cross-class ranks cost twice as many skill points and have a lower maximum.
